chapter_title: Concerning the Four Works of the Ambassador
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** At the time when the Divine Emissary of Wisdom made manifest his spiritual form to the lower degrees of the mind, four complete operations of regeneration were disclosed — each supremely excellent and surpassing all prior works.

**¶2:** The first is the form of Divine Truth itself, which presented itself in the radiance of its own glory to the understanding.

**¶3:** The second is that all passages of communication between the successive degrees of the mind were opened at that time. They open [GAP-1: *the spiritual sense requires: before the descent of Divine Truth through each successive degree*] and close again behind the influx once it has passed through.

**¶4:** The third is the wisdom and the liberation of good from bondage to falsity, which were refined and purified by the presence of that Divine Form. That wisdom so liberated is greater than the wisdom that the Divine shall [GAP-2: *the spiritual sense requires: impart through any subsequent or lesser influx into the natural mind*].

**¶5:** The fourth: The Divine has [GAP-3: made manifest], through the perfection of the regenerate human state, the receptacle formed to convey redeemed wisdom upward through the degrees. The Divine has [GAP-4: *the spiritual sense requires: gathered into that receptacle and brought forth*] the living affection for good — which radiated in completeness and fullness throughout all the states dominated by enmity and falsity, reclaiming what had been held captive there.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: At the time when the Ambassador displayed his image, four great works were revealed that are very excellent and outstanding.
The first is his image that he displayed in a glorious image.
The second is all the doors of the firmaments that were opened at that time. They open [before him] and shut behind him.
The third is the light and the releasing that was purified by his image. That light is more than the light that he shall [purify hereafter]
The fourth: He has [made manifest], by the perfection of people, his light ship. He has [gathered] the living soul that shone forth in perfection and fullness over the worlds of enmity.

fills.explanation: The doors of the firmaments open before the Ambassador as he descends through successive degrees and shut behind him after his influx has passed — a classic Kephalaia description of sequential passage through discrete degrees.

The spiritual reading indicates this light surpasses what the Divine will impart through any subsequent or lesser influx; in the Kephalaia's register of purification, the light released by this supreme manifestation exceeds what he shall purify in any later operation.

The spiritual reading confirms the meaning "made manifest"; while the editor's "made apparent" is close, "made manifest" is the more standard Kephalaia term (Coptic ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ) for the revealing of a hidden spiritual reality through a perfected state.

The spiritual reading calls for "gathered into that receptacle and brought forth"; in the Kephalaia's vocabulary, the light ship gathers the living soul from captivity in the worlds of enmity, corresponding to the collection of redeemed good into its proper receptacle.
